items: Her hats lie on the Cloakroom floor: walk up to one and press E to wear it, leaving the one she had on in its place
A new Band card at the mirror: one colour for the hat's glowing band and its plume
Short cloaks go down to the knee, long cloaks from the knee down
Cloak and scarf lengths are on their own cards
The cloak pegs stand in the Cloakroom's north-east corner, and last night's clothes lie in the middle of the bedroom
